chars.Y: YOUNES: a middle-aged man wearing a charcoal grey suit, a mustard yellow tie and thin round black glasses.
chars.B: BOSS: a tall manager wearing a burgundy blazer over a white shirt with a bright red bow tie.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a modern glass office high in an American city skyscraper. YOUNES sits alone at his desk in front of a laptop, leaning back with a sly satisfied grin and a small fist pump, city lights behind him.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES at his office desk, glancing sideways secretly while typing on a computer; green dollar bills magically stream out of the computer screen and fly into an open black briefcase next to him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a huge bank vault of a big American corporation, enormous mountains of stacked green dollar bills and gold, dramatic light, a heavy round vault door wide open. No people.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night in a modern kitchen of an American house, YOUNES stands at the table staring with greedy determined eyes at a tall stack of dollar bundles, one hand clenched.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Busy open-plan office in daytime: colleagues walk past carrying folders without noticing anything, while YOUNES at his desk forces a nervous innocent smile, a drop of sweat on his forehead.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES closes his laptop with relief and leans back in his office chair with eyes closed, exhaling, evening light through the window.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Sunny morning on a busy American city sidewalk with tall buildings, YOUNES walks calmly to work holding a coffee cup and a leather bag, relaxed, like a normal day.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Tense corporate boardroom: BOSS stands at the head of a long table slamming his fist on it with an angry worried face, other managers look shocked, and YOUNES sits at the far end of the table frozen and sweating, eyes wide.
